title: What Self-Correcting Memory Chips Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Self-correcting memory chips are memory devices that find and fix their own errors continuously: on-chip ECC engines, scrubbers, and adaptive refresh that detect bit flips from cosmic rays or aging and repair them before software ever notices — memory that never returns a wrong bit. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Self-Correcting Memory Chips: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Self-Correcting Memory Chips in one line: Self-correcting memory chips are memory devices that find and fix their own errors continuously: on-chip ECC engines, scrubbers, and adaptive refresh that detect bit flips from cosmic rays or aging and repair them before software ever notices — memory that never returns a wrong bit.
Why it matters: As memories scale, errors are inevitable; self-correction makes them invisible..
Where it is used: servers, aerospace, automotive, AI accelerators, medical devices..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
